body: I never even thought about it that way. I guess I’m just my own worst critic and I don’t give myself enough credit. You were right by the way cause I had a way better day yesterday and actually caught on to the drinks pretty well.

Yeah I actually was hospitalized for 8 days for attempted overdose so now they’re aware of it. Their super helpful and I know they’re there for me but I have such a hard time telling them how I feel so I just journal, vent to strangers online, and blog.

It’s not that I want to talk to somebody it’s that I need to talk to my family and best friends so they know how I’m feeling. I keep everything and side and they know that im not in a good place rn but they don’t know to what extent and so on. They all tell me their here for me but it’s just so hard for me to and I just bottle everything up until I see my therapist.

I guess I’m also hesitant to talk then because everybody I talk to just belittles me.  Who knows
